scope: Stabilize the FE022.VS02 browser assertion without changing product behavior.
consumers: UIC07 exact-SHA GitHub Actions and S17 evidence

observed.approvalListGet: GET /api/v2/shops/shop-demo/approvals?limit=20 returned HTTP 200 and contained approval-10005 for purchaseorder-10002 with status pending
observed.pageAtFailure: The approvals main list still exposed its loading status and the target row was absent from the accessibility snapshot.

diagnosis: The request and response data were correct; the test started its five-second DOM assertion immediately after navigation and did not wait for the main approvals-list response. Under the measured Firefox CI run, the view was still loading at assertion timeout. Add a response barrier for the exact limit=20 list request, assert the target approval is in its payload, then retain the existing visible-row assertion.
verificationRequired: Run FE022.VS02 in Chromium and Firefox on this source.
Run npm run verify and npm run test:e2e with recorded exit codes.
Refresh only stale S17 fingerprints through the owning evidence workflow and rerun the S17 validator.
Commit separately in Vietnamese and verify exact-SHA push and pull-request workflows before the next UIC commit.
